brief:
More than 25 dockworkers' trade unions across 110 ports in 22 countries plan a coordinated strike on October 30, according to Al Jazeera English. The action represents an unprecedented mobilization of port workers globally around the Gaza situation.

The strike aims to exert economic pressure through disruption of global shipping and trade flows. Port shutdowns can halt the movement of goods, affecting supply chains and forcing attention to the cause the workers are supporting.
dek: More than 25 dockworkers' trade unions in 110 ports of 22 countries are going on strike on October 30.
title: Dockworkers in 22 countries strike over Gaza on October 30
